Container.Name: qbit-monitor-rss
Container.Overview:
qbit-monitor-rss

Self-hosted web app that monitors multiple qBittorrent instances and automatically adds new releases from private-tracker RSS feeds to the instance of your choice, under a configurable 50-200 slot cap with zero cross-instance duplicates.

Features:

  • Multi-instance qBittorrent support (one tab per instance)
  • RSS 2.0 + Atom feed parsing (enclosure and <link href> torrents)
  • Dedup by info-hash (added + live client) and normalized title
  • Configurable slot cap (50-200) with slot release after a seed-time requirement
  • Manual + automatic feed scans
  • Persistent state (SQLite + config.json) in /data
  • Built-in web GUI, no external frontend build
  • Multi-arch images (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64) on GHCR

Documentation: GitHub repo
Container.Description: Monitor multiple qBittorrent instances and auto-add private-tracker RSS items under a configurable 50-200 slot cap.

Field.Name: WebUI
Field.Description: qbit-monitor-rss web interface. Configure instances, feeds, and settings from here.

Field.Name: WebUI Port
Field.Description: Host port for the web UI. Change this to map the app to a different port on your Unraid host.

Field.Name: AppData
Field.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and config.json. Back this folder up to keep your instances, feeds, and slot state.

Field.Name: User-Agent
Field.Description: Optional HTTP User-Agent override. Some trackers only serve feeds to known clients or require a custom UA.
